children.label: feat
children.description: New behavior, capability or supported workflow.

children.label: fix
children.description: Correction to broken, incorrect or regressed behavior.

children.label: nit
children.description: Small polish, copy adjustment or low-risk cleanup.

label: priority
description: The relative importance and urgency of the work.

children.label: high
children.description: Needed soon, blocks other work or materially affects core behavior.

children.label: medium
children.description: Valuable, but not urgent or blocking.

label: phase
description: The current stage of work; lifecycle and phase contracts define its gates.

children.label: research
children.description: Establish facts needed to shape a testable specification.

children.label: refinement
children.description: Define scope, acceptance criteria and verification scenarios.

children.label: implementation
children.description: Produce a reviewable change and self-check evidence for QA.

children.label: qa
children.description: Judge the change against the specification using evidence for identified versions.

children.label: integration
children.description: Validate the change in its integration destination.

children.label: deployment
children.description: Establish deployment as a separate fact from QA and integration.

label: status
description: The work's availability or activity, separate from its phase.

children.label: doing
children.description: Work is actively in progress in the current phase.

children.label: blocked
children.description: The current phase needs unavailable input, access or an external decision; record the missing prerequisite and resume condition.

children.label: duplicate
children.description: Tracks the same outcome as another work item.
